products.name: Super Thin 600D Aramid
products.thicknessNote: Advertised shell thickness, not closed-device depth.
products.summary: A light aramid front-and-back set supplied with an outer-screen protector.
limitations: Designed for light daily protection. The maker expressly excludes severe-drop protection.
No front lip or button covers. The hinge is exposed in the official photograph.
The page gives both 22 g and 0.75 oz. Weight is approximate, not independently measured.
products.shippingNote: International orders may ship from Texas or China. UK duties and delivery need confirmation.

products.name: Edge · Back Case Only
products.thicknessNote: Black/Grey back shell: 1.0 ±0.1 mm; 15.9 ±0.2 g. Other finishes may differ.
products.summary: A minimal aramid back shell with capacitive Camera Control and an exposed hinge.
limitations: Back only. The front frame and outer display need separate protection.
Some magnetic wallets and batteries extend below the case.

products.name: Edge · Front Case with Glass
products.summary: An aramid front frame bonded to anti-reflective glass. A separate back case is required.
limitations: Front only. Back and hinge remain uncovered.
Glass and frame are bonded. The maker advises against separating them.
Not compatible with an additional screen protector.

products.name: Edge · Suite without Hinge
products.thicknessNote: Sunset set: 1.3 ±0.1 mm; 36.7 ±2 g. Not closed-device depth.
products.summary: A matching aramid back and glass-front set with capacitive Camera Control.
limitations: Front glass is bonded to its frame and does not accept another protector.
Selected Sunset set showed Coming Soon despite a generic Place in Cart header.
